text:
Effervescence is observed at the negative electrode (cathode) during the electrolysis of
concentrated aqueous sodium chloride.
Which element is produced at the negative electrode (cathode)?
A
chlorine
B
hydrogen
C
oxygen
D
sodium
subject: Chemistry
